checks_run:
Everything ran on derby/main 12e8e1d, in the worktree /tmp/rt/controls/repo (bun run build: "built in 388 ms, 1131 KB"). The bun scripts are in /tmp/rt/controls/out/m; run them with `cd /tmp/rt/controls/out/m && /root/.bun/bin/bun <file>`. The .cjs browser scripts need NODE_PATH=/opt/node22/lib/node_modules and use the SwiftShader Chromium at 1280x800, about 6 fps. Prior scratch scripts in /tmp/rt/controls/out were re-run, and their scene bugs were fixed or rewritten.

Click passes:
- passes.ts, 8/15/25/35 m from midfield, 24 per cell. A standing receiver completes 24/24 at every distance. Airborne: 0 of 384. Kick speeds are 11.5/15.9/18.9/21.3 m/s. The ball arrives at 9.5/12.5/13.2/13.5 m/s after 0.51/0.81/1.28/1.71 s. A receiver running across at 6 m/s completes 24/24.

- Deciding in 500 ms instead of 200 ms: 68%, 1.8 per possession.

First touch (firsttouch.ts): only receivers with dribbling 0.15 lose 25-35 m passes. Outfield dribbling has min 0.12 and 10th percentile 0.36.

Shots (shots.ts, 27 per cell), still keeper:

| 18 m | 5/16/6 | 11/7/9 | 6/8/13 |

Peak height is only 0.12-0.35 m. A shuffling keeper gave about the same numbers.

findings.title: Collecting a loose ball (or receiving while being steered) stops the human's player dead until the mouse moves for 8 ticks
findings.evidence:
src/sim/match.ts:1057 in control(): `if (isHumanControlled(s, p) && s.ctlHold) s.ctlHold[p.team] = true;` re-arms the 'stale pointer' hold every time the player the human is ALREADY steering takes the ball. Then human.ts:211-215 zeroes his move while held. README says the hold applies only 'if you have not moved the mouse since' the pass.

Measurements:
- pickup.ts: steering at 8.4 m/s with the pointer still 10.7 m ahead, he picks up a loose ball. Speed is 4.0 m/s at +10 ticks and 0.0 at +20 and +40. With the pointer moved every 3rd tick it is also 0.0 at +20. With it moved every tick it dips to 4.4 m/s.
- runon.ts: the human moves the pointer every tick, steering a runner onto a pass. On receipt he is at 2.2 m/s, then 0.0 m/s for the next second while the pointer rests 10.6 m ahead (held=true).
- Real browser pipeline (pickup_live.cjs): speeds 7.2-7.8 m/s, then 0.0 within about 10 ticks, held ('HHHH...') for the whole 3 s trace. A 1 px mouse twitch every 150 ms did not release him.
- Frequency (pickup_freq.ts, 8 whole matches): 17-19 such pickups per 6-minute match. With a hand resting between moves, 50 of 64 fast pickups (>4 m/s) stopped dead. With a hand moving every tick, he still lost 2.6 m/s on average, against about 0.7 m/s expected from the dribbling speed cap.
findings.repro:
cd /tmp/rt/controls/out/m && /root/.bun/bin/bun pickup.ts && /root/.bun/bin/bun runon.ts && /root/.bun/bin/bun pickup_freq.ts
Browser: NODE_PATH=/opt/node22/lib/node_modules node /tmp/rt/controls/out/m/pickup_live.cjs
findings.suggested_fix:
In src/sim/match.ts control() (line 1057), do not re-arm ctlHold for a player who was already controlled. The hold is already armed on an automatic change of player, by give(..., auto=true) in src/sim/human.ts:290-297 and the end-of-tick handover at match.ts:1556-1560. Alternatively, arm it only when the pointer has not moved since our team's last kick (keep a moved-since-kick flag in MatchState).

Keep the stale-pointer tests (tests/physics.test.ts:235 and :251). Add a test that a steered player who collects a loose ball with the pointer resting ahead keeps running, and one for a receiver steered on during the pass.

findings.title: Right-click tackle: no win zone from 1.7-2.4 m, and slides from beyond 3 m slide through the ball but can never win it
findings.evidence:
How the code decides:
- src/sim/human.ts:73 picks a standing tackle when the POINTER is within STAND_TACKLE_R = 2.4 m.
- src/sim/match.ts:369-371 resolves the tackle instantly, at the click, against the CARRIER's distance, with reach 1.7 m standing and 3 m sliding.
- A carrier 1.7-2.4 m away with the pointer on him is therefore a standing tackle that cannot reach.
- Players are separated to at least 1.3 m (PLAYER_R 0.65), so the working standing window is only 1.3-1.7 m.

Whole matches (tackle_match.ts, 6 matches for each click radius; scripted human right-clicks on the carrier):
| click distance | clicks | won | fouls |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1.2-1.7 m (standing) | 81 | 51% | 21% |
| 1.7-2.4 m (standing) | 66 | 3% | 3% |
| 2.4-3.0 m (slide) | 41 | 24% | 56% |
| 3-6 m (slide) | 96 | 1% | 1% |
In the 1.7-2.4 m band it was 0/30 and 1/55 at other radii.

Other evidence:
- tackles.ts: 1.9 m and 2.2 m with the pointer on the carrier gave 0/40 won; every miss then costs a 36-tick tackle cooldown.
- slide.ts: slides at a still carrier 3.5/4.5/5.5 m away travel 2.4/2.8/3.2 m and come within 0.51-0.56 m of the ball. They never win, because a stunned slider can't touch the ball. The README Controls row says 'slides go up to 6 m'.
- In the 3D view a click on the carrier's waist or chest lands 1.5-2 m up-screen of his feet. From 1.5 m, where a standing tackle would win about 40-50%, that becomes a slide from 46-54% of approach directions (tackle_aim3d.ts), and slides foul 30-56%.
findings.suggested_fix:
1. Make the stand-or-slide choice depend on the carrier's distance, and match it to the reach. For example, if a carrier is within 2.4 m of the pointer, use the distance to him, and set standing reach to that threshold (or STAND_TACKLE_R = 1.7).
2. Resolve a slide over its travel: each tick of the lunge, sweep the slider's feet against the ball and decide there, instead of an instant range check at the click. Then the 'up to 6 m' slide can actually win the ball.
3. Snap a right click on a carrier's body to the carrier (see the body-click finding).

Files: src/sim/human.ts (STAND_TACKLE_R, the humanIntent tackle branch at lines 257-266), src/sim/match.ts applyAction tackle (lines 360-420), README Controls row. Add tests for 1.8-2.3 m standing tackles and for a 4 m slide that reaches the ball.

findings.title: Hold-to-loft passes to a team-mate's feet are almost never controlled where they land: they come off him, skip on 13-23 m, and the held receiver doesn't chase
findings.area: ball in the air / reception (owner ask 4)
findings.evidence:
Root causes:
- src/sim/match.ts:334: a loft is kicked with receiver -1, so it never gets the +5 receiver bonus in control() at match.ts:1034.
- The control 'speed' is |v| + 0.5|vz| (match.ts:1031), and the chest limit is x0.75.
- A landing ball keeps 82% of its pace on the bounce (match.ts:768).
- An auto-switched, held human man is moved by aiIntent, which excludes him as chaser (src/sim/ai.ts:316 `if (chaser === human) chaser = -1`), so no team-mate chases.

Measurements (all with no defenders on the pitch):
- loft_contact.ts: 20/25/30 m lofts meet a receiver standing on the spot at a 'speed' of 14.7/16.1/17.3 against his limit of 9.8/13.0/13.0 (dribbling 0.64). The ball comes off him at 4.8-9.5 m/s. A 35 m loft passes him.
- loft_pinned.ts: the receiver stands exactly where the loft lands, or 0.5/1 m short, at 3 angles. A CPU mate takes 0/27. A human-steered mate takes 3/9 at 15 m (only when exactly on the spot) and 0/18 at 25-35 m.
- loft_human.ts, 15 lofts per row (flights 1.4/1.9/2.4 s at 15/25/35 m):
  - Pointer kept on the target: the mate gets it 1/15, 1/15 and 0/15 at 15/25/35 m. Usually nobody touches it within 8 s.
  - Pointer jiggled on the landing spot: 0/15 at all three distances.
  - Pointer chasing the ball: 14/15, 15/15 and 9/15, but only after median 4.0/5.2/6.3 s, and the ball ends a median 13-23 m past the aim (6/15 go out at 35 m).
- loft_trace.ts (25 m loft, pointer still): the target is auto-switched at 0.82 s and held. CPU positioning runs him from (50.6,34) to (75,11) while the ball lands at x=55, bounces to 1.37 m, and rolls to x=73.4 untouched for 8 s.
- CPU v CPU (cpu_lofts.ts, 125 lofted passes): only 26% are kept.
- The loft charge itself is clear (loft-hold640-1280.png shows the dots and the landing ring on the team-mate), so players will try this pass.
findings.repro: cd /tmp/rt/controls/out/m && /root/.bun/bin/bun loft_human.ts && /root/.bun/bin/bun loft_pinned.ts && /root/.bun/bin/bun loft_contact.ts && /root/.bun/bin/bun loft_trace.ts still 25 && /root/.bun/bin/bun cpu_lofts.ts
findings.suggested_fix:
1. Give lofts a receiver. Run assistReceiver (src/sim/kicks.ts) on the landing point and pass it to kick() at match.ts:334. That gives the receiver bonus, and updateControl hands him over at once.
2. For a dropping ball taken by its receiver, judge control on horizontal pace, or weight vz much less than 0.5, so chest and thigh control works as the README promises.
3. Damp the first bounce on grass more (0.82 to about 0.6 horizontal) so lofts sit up near where they land.
4. In src/sim/human.ts humanIntent, a held man chases a loose ball with no other receiver (use meetBall) instead of aiIntent's positional target. This avoids touching ai.ts, which PR #7 is reworking.

Add tests: a 25 m loft to a team-mate standing on the spot is controlled within 0.5 s of landing; a held receiver goes to a loose loft.

findings.title: A second click just after a kick is read as the no-ball action: a double click (or a click on the receiver) taps the pass away, and a double right click slides the striker onto the floor
findings.evidence:
How it happens: input.ts:299-313 turns a press without the ball into select (left) or tackle (right). For the receiver of an incoming pass, human.ts:199-205 queues that select as a first-time pass to the grass under the pointer, which is on the receiver himself. kicks.ts:229 then plays it 2 m on.

Measurements:
- dblclick.ts (the exact input sequence the controller sends at 60 fps): passes of 8-20 m with a second press 83-333 ms after the release. In 6/6 runs the receiver controls it and immediately pushes it on at 4.9-5.4 m/s, ending 6.0-13.8 m from him.
- Live (dbl_live.cjs): a click on the receiver 350 ms after the pass queued a first-time kick, and the ball ended loose 6.1 m from him.
- dblright.ts: a second right press 100-250 ms after a shot is a slide toward the goal. The striker spends 30 ticks (0.5 s) on the floor with a 70-tick tackle cooldown, so he can't follow up a rebound.
findings.repro: cd /tmp/rt/controls/out && /root/.bun/bin/bun dblclick.ts; cd m && /root/.bun/bin/bun dblright.ts; NODE_PATH=/opt/node22/lib/node_modules node /tmp/rt/controls/out/m/dbl_live.cjs
findings.suggested_fix:
- In src/client/input.ts, ignore a press that comes within about 250 ms of the previous kick release, or has MouseEvent.detail >= 2.
- In src/sim/human.ts:199-205, do not queue a first-time pass whose aim is within about 3 m of the receiver himself; treat it as 'take it'.
- Do not start a tackle from a right press within about 300 ms of your own shot.
- Add a test in tests/physics.test.ts.

findings.title: Clicks while a restart is being set up are silently swallowed
findings.evidence:
How it happens:
- During the 'setup' stage, beginSetup sets ball.owner to the human's taker (match.ts:1376-1381), so matchView's hasBall() is true and input.ts turns a click into a pass.
- But stepRestart's setup branch (match.ts:1441-1444) never calls humanIntent for the taker, so the kick is dropped.

Live (restart_live.cjs): at our throw-in, a left click at setup tick 10 still shows stage 'setup' at tick 74, with no restartTaken event. The player has to click again once 'ready' arrives (goal kick setup is 50 ticks, corners 85, near free kicks 85).

Screenshot /tmp/rt/controls/out/restart-setup-1280.png: the taker walks to the line with no wedge or 'wait' cue. The wedge appears only in restart-ready-1280.png.

Right clicks behave sensibly: a long throw at 19.4 m/s at a throw-in, a 20 m/s ground drive at a corner, nothing on the opponent's throw-in.
findings.suggested_fix: In src/sim/match.ts stepRestart, during 'setup' keep the human's last kick action (pass, loft or shoot) and play it as soon as the stage turns 'ready'. Or report hasBall() as false until 'ready' and show a dimmed wedge or 'wait' state in the aim layer. Add a rules test.

findings.title: Human shots never leave the ground: a full-power strike from 25 m peaks at 0.33 m
findings.evidence:
shots.ts, 162 right-click shots at 12/18/25 m and power 0.55/0.8/1.0: maximum ball height 0.12-0.35 m.

Human shoot actions never set `lift` (human.ts:231-233). applyAction gives the ball height only when action.lift is set (match.ts:345-357), so every human shot rolls at 22-30 m/s. Holding right only adds pace and scatter: misses go from 5/27 to 15/27 at 25 m. There is no way to put a shot into the top corner or over a low keeper.
findings.suggested_fix: In src/sim/human.ts, set `lift` from the hold power. For example, a quick click stays low and full power rises to about 1.5-2.2 m at the goal line. Keep it under the bar with the existing error model in src/sim/match.ts. Add a test and a README note.

findings.title: Trackpad pinch (Ctrl+wheel) zooms the browser page, not the camera
findings.evidence:
src/client/renderer.ts:195 `if (e.ctrlKey) return; // pinch-zoom of the page`.

wheel_live.cjs: 15 Ctrl+wheel events (the way a Mac trackpad pinch arrives) left the camera zoom at 1.383, with defaultPrevented on 0/15. So the browser zooms the whole page and HUD. On phones the same pinch zooms the camera, and two-finger scroll on the trackpad zooms smoothly (1 to 1.146 over 40 x 3 px, inertia to 1.383).
findings.suggested_fix: In src/client/renderer.ts onWheel, when the event is over the pitch, treat ctrlKey wheel as camera zoom. Call preventDefault and scale by deltaY with a higher gain, since pinch deltas are small.

findings.title: 3D clicks are picked on the ground plane only: clicking a team-mate's head sends the pass to the man behind him
findings.area: controls / pass assist and player pick in 3D
findings.evidence:
renderer3d.ts:371-387 toWorld intersects only the ground. The camera is 33 degrees down from the y=68 side (camera3d.ts:48,80), so a click on a body at height h lands about 1.54 x h m up-screen of his feet. At the default zoom he is about 29 px tall (bodyclick_live.cjs: feet at y=444, head at y=415).

- Live: clicking his head (1.65 m) passed to the team-mate 4 m behind him. Feet, waist and chest clicks reached him.
- bodyclick.ts: with a second team-mate 4 m up-screen, chest or head clicks pass to the other man 100% at 8/15/25 m, and a left-click pick goes to the other man 46%.
- Alone, a head click on a team-mate 6 m away passes to him only 8%.
- The receiver ring does show the wrong man beforehand: bodyclick-hover-chest-1280.png and -crop.png.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a player pick to src/client/r3d/renderer3d.ts. Raycast the players' body cylinders (radius about 0.35 m, 0-1.9 m tall) first, and when the ray hits one return his feet (or his index) for the aim and the select. Then use it in src/client/input.ts toWorld for pointerdown.

findings.title: Header aim uses the pointer's absolute y, so aiming at a post pulls the striker off the ball's line
findings.evidence:
src/sim/match.ts:1287 aims a human header at clamp(pointer.y, post ± 0.4). The same pointer also steers him.

header.ts, 8 crosses per row at 2.1 m to a striker at (96,34):
| pointer | headed | into the goal mouth | goals |
|---|---|---|---|
| on him | 8/8 | 7 | 1 |
| 2 m toward the top post | 8/8 | 5 | 2 |
| 4 m toward the top post | 7/8 | 4 | 0 |
| on the top post | 0/8 (he runs away) | 0 | 0 |
findings.suggested_fix: In src/sim/match.ts header(), aim by the side of the pointer relative to the striker. For example, the pointer's offset from him scaled up, so 0.5 m either side picks a corner while he stays in the dead zone. Or let a click queued while the ball is in the air, like the first-time shot queue in src/sim/human.ts, choose the corner.

findings.title: The mouse coach tip never mentions hold-to-loft; only the touch tip does
findings.evidence:
src/client/coach.ts:43 (mouse): 'Left click to pass: the ball rolls to the pointer...', with no word of holding. coach.ts:45 (touch): 'Hold it a little longer to loft the ball.'

Nothing appears on press until the charge starts at 300 ms. The only mouse cue is 'hold left loft' in the one-line hint under the pitch (visible in loft-hold640-1280.png).
findings.suggested_fix: Add 'Hold the button for a lofted ball: the dots show where it lands' to the mouse pass tip in src/client/coach.ts, or a later one-time tip the first time the player has the ball with a team-mate over 20 m away.

good: A click is always a ground pass: 0 of 384 scene passes were airborne, and about 1 in 1000 in whole matches. Live, 290 ms gave a ground pass and 320 ms a loft. The kick lands 1 tick after release.

Click passes are well weighted. Kick speeds are 11.5-21.3 m/s, arriving at 9.5-13.5 m/s in 0.51-1.71 s over 8-35 m. Open receivers complete 24/24, running receivers 24/24, and none came off a receiver.
Tiki-taka with simple clicks works: 80-86% completion and 3.7-5.2 completed passes per possession with up to 2 m aim error.
Keeper control does what the owner asked: the human steers him, a 6..0 countdown shows, the CPU releases at exactly 6.00 s, and clicks roll, throw or punt. He can walk in his box.
Ball-body collisions are solid: nothing passes through a body below 1.85 m within 0.35 m, and opponents head balls at 1.7-2.3 m.
Pointer following is smooth: no overshoot, no direction reversals, a 0.56 m stop, and a 183 ms direction change. Trackpad scroll zoom is smooth.
Auto-switch while defending steers the man nearest the ball 83% of ticks and stays within 3 m of him 98%.
The loft charge is clear on desktop and phone: flight dots and a landing ring from 300 ms, with the wedge as the power gauge.

verdicts.title: Collecting a loose ball (or receiving while being steered) stops the human's player dead until the mouse moves for 8 ticks
verdicts.notes:
Reproduced in my own worktree /tmp/rt/controls-verify/repo. derby/main is now 2cfa17c: #19 merged after 12e8e1d and changed nothing in src/sim.

What I ran and saw:
- /tmp/rt/controls-verify/out/pickup.ts: the steered player runs at 8.4 m/s onto a still loose ball, with the pointer resting 12.9 m ahead. After pickup his speed is 6.3 m/s at +5 ticks, 4.1 at +10 and 0.0 at +20, and stays 0.0 to +60. held stays true the whole time.
  - Pointer moved every 3rd tick: 0.0 at +20, released around +30.
  - Pointer moved every tick: dips to 6.3 m/s, then recovers.
- through.ts: a through ball into space (receiver -1) onto a runner the human is steering. He has it at 8.3 m/s, then 0.0 by +20 and held for 1 s if the hand rests. Even with the hand moving every tick he dips to 6.2 m/s.
- Real browser (pickup_live.cjs, 2D renderer, real page.mouse events): pickup at 8.3 m/s, 3.9 at +10, 0.0 at +20, held through +180 ticks. A 1 px twitch every 150 ms also stays held; that part is by design, because MOVE_PX is 2 px per tick (input.ts:98).
- Screenshot /tmp/rt/controls-verify/out/pickup_live.png: #9 stands still with the ball while the pass line runs about 12 m ahead to the resting pointer reticle.
- Frequency (pickup_freq.ts, 5 matches per hand model, 2 x 3 min): 8.8-19 loose-ball pickups by the already-steered player per match.
  - Hand moving 6 of every 20 ticks: 39 of 57 fast (>4 m/s) pickups were below 1 m/s 20 ticks later; mean loss 4.2 m/s.
  - Hand moving every tick: no stops, mean loss 1.4 m/s.

Root cause:
- src/sim/match.ts:1057, in control(), re-arms ctlHold every time the player the human already steers takes the ball.
- human.ts:211-215 then zeroes his move.
- updateControl (human.ts:303-306) needs HOLD_MOVES = 8 ticks of at least 2 px movement to release him.
- Every real automatic change already arms the hold: give(auto) at human.ts:291-297, the end-of-tick handover at match.ts:1556-1560, and restart setup at match.ts:1387 and rules.ts:508. So line 1057 only fires when no change of player happened, which contradicts the README ('If you have not moved the mouse since...').

Fix, checked locally and reverted: delete match.ts:1057, or arm it only if the pointer has not moved since our team's last kick.
- With it removed, the pickup keeps 7.7 m/s at +10 and slows naturally toward the resting pointer; the through-ball runner keeps 7.5 m/s.
- All 544 unit tests still pass, including the stale-pointer tests at physics.test.ts:235 and :251. Scripted tiki-taka is unchanged at 84% and 4.14 passes per possession.
- Add tests: a steered player collecting a loose ball with the pointer resting ahead keeps running, and a runner taking a through ball into space keeps running.

verdicts.title: Right-click tackle: no win zone from 1.7-2.4 m, and slides from beyond 3 m slide through the ball but can never win it
verdicts.notes:
Reproduced, though 'slides through the ball' is overstated.

What I ran and saw:
- /tmp/rt/controls-verify/out/tackle.ts: 60 seeds per distance, default attributes, pointer and aim on the carrier, won counted by stats.tackles.

| carrier distance | tackle | won | fouls |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1.3 / 1.5 / 1.7 m | standing | 11/60 | 10/60 |
| 1.8 / 2.0 / 2.2 / 2.4 m | standing | 0/60 | 0/60 |
| 2.6 / 2.9 m | slide | 11/60 | 18/60 |
| 3.2 / 3.6 / 4.5 / 5.5 m | slide | 0/60 | 0/60 |

  - Every miss in the 1.8-2.4 m band still costs tackleCd 36 and a 10-tick stun.
  - A carrier running across at 5 m/s gives the same pattern.
- slide2.ts, carrier frozen with the ball: slides from 3.2-4.0 m travel 2.5-2.7 m and end in body contact with the carrier (1.30 m apart, which is 2 x PLAYER_R). There is no tackle and no foul, and the ball stays his. From 4.5 and 5.5 m they stop 1.5 and 2.4 m short.
  - Travel never exceeds about 3 m, although the README says 'slides go up to 6 m'.
  - Closest approach to the ball was at least 0.8 m, because separation stops him at the carrier's body. So the slide reaches the man, not through the ball, and does nothing. That looks broken.
- Body-click sub-claim: not reproduced in a browser. renderer3d.ts:371 toWorld is a plain ground-plane raycast with no snap to players, so a click on a chest at about 1.3 m under the 33-degree camera lands about 2 m beyond the feet. That supports the claim.

Root cause:
- human.ts:261 chooses standing or slide by the POINTER's distance against STAND_TACKLE_R = 2.4 (human.ts:73).
- match.ts:369-371 resolves the tackle once, at the click, against the CARRIER's distance, with reach 1.7 standing and 3 sliding.
- A miss stuns the tackler (match.ts:381, 30 ticks for a slide), and stunned players are skipped for ball contact (match.ts:1002 and the contacts() feet loop). So the travelling slide can never win.
- controls.test.ts:498-500 only covers a pointer at 2 m with the carrier at 2.6 m, never a pointer on a carrier inside the band.

Fix:
1. In the humanIntent tackle branch (human.ts:257-266), when the pointer is within about 1.5 m of an opposing carrier, decide on the carrier's distance, and make the threshold equal to standing reach (STAND_TACKLE_R = 1.7, or raise standing reach to 2.4 with a lower pWin at range).
2. In applyAction (match.ts:360-420), resolve a slide over its lunge: each tick of the first ~15, test the slider's feet against the ball and the carrier within about 1 m, and win or foul there, instead of the instant 3 m check.
3. Correct the README Controls row ('up to 6 m') and the coach tip in coach.ts:57.
4. Add tests: a 1.8-2.3 m standing tackle with the pointer on the carrier can win; a 4 m slide that reaches the carrier wins or fouls.

Major stands: tackling is the human's only defensive action, and the dead band is right where a player clicks on the man in front of him.

verdicts.title: Hold-to-loft passes to a team-mate's feet are almost never controlled where they land: they come off him, skip on 13-23 m, and the held receiver doesn't chase
verdicts.notes:
Reproduced. Lofts were played in our own half; my first run in their half was spoiled by offside.

What I ran and saw:
- /tmp/rt/controls-verify/out/loftpinned.ts: the team-mate is pinned on the computed landing spot, or 0.5 m or 1 m short. Over 15-35 m, 3 hold levels and 3 seeds, he controlled 1 of 135. Every other contact came off him.
  - Control 'speed' at contact was 13.4-18.7, against his limit of 13.0 (dribbling 0.64), x0.75 on the chest.
  - The ball left him at 3-10 m/s.
- loft.ts, a free team-mate standing on the target, 24 trials per row:
  - CPU mate: 0 controlled at landing. He runs under the flight (lofttrace.ts: from 33 back to 28.1 while the ball passes at z = 2.6) and only gets it after 3.5-5.9 s, 12-23 m past the aim.
  - Human, pointer still: 1-7/24. The target is auto-switched at about 0.8 s and held, and aiIntent runs him away. lofttrace.ts still 25: from (33,34) to (55,15) while the ball rolls untouched to (51.9,34.5).
  - Pointer jiggled on the spot: 6/24 at 15 m, 0/24 at 20-35 m. He meets it at z of about 1.9 at speed 15.6, it skips off, and he stops at the pointer.
  - Pointer chasing the ball: 16-24/24, but after a median 5.2-7.5 s and 12.5-23.5 m past the aim.
- cpulofts.ts, CPU v CPU over 6 matches: 43 open-play chips, 23% kept, against 71% of 1053 ground passes with a receiver.

Root causes:
- match.ts:334 kicks lofts and chips with receiver -1: no +5 receiver bonus (match.ts:1034), no RECEIVE_REACH and no control handover.
- match.ts:1031 counts 0.5|vz| in the control speed, and the chest limit is x0.75 (match.ts:1035).
- The bounce at match.ts:768 keeps 82% of the horizontal pace.
- A held human is moved by aiIntent, and ai.ts:316 drops the human's player as chaser, so nobody on our side goes to the ball.

Fix, sketched locally and reverted:
1. Pass assistReceiver(s, p, b.pos, plan.landing) as the receiver at match.ts:334 (not for punts).
2. Weight vz at 0.15 for the intended receiver in control().
3. In human.ts meetBall, an airborne ball (z > 1.9 or vz > 0) sends him to where it drops to chest height, not under its flight. Without this, a receiver at 25-35 m still ran under the ball: 4.3-5.8 s and 15-23 m past.

With 1-3: the pinned mate controls 9/9 at 15-25 m, and the free mate has 15-25 m lofts in 1.2-1.8 s about 2 m from the aim (24/24 in every pointer mode). 30-35 m lofts still need tuning: about 12/24 and 2/24, so also damp the first bounce (0.82 to about 0.6) or judge a receiver's dropping ball on horizontal pace only.

Add tests: a 25 m loft to a team-mate standing on the spot is controlled within 0.5 s of landing, and the receiver goes to a loose loft even when held. This avoids touching ai.ts (PR #7).
